```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "ext.ent">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Root level comment combining namespaces and entities -->
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
  <child sub:id="1" xlink:type="simple">&internal;</child>
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities;, and <!-- comments --> inside.
    ]]>
  </child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Entity Data'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<!-- Top comment -->
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://example.org/meta">
  <?m-pi test="active"?>
  <section m:role="header">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with markup: <section>&ent;</section>
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value One">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Value Two">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ELEMENT comment_holder (#PCDATA)>">
  %pEnt;
  <?xml-stylesheet href="catalog.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Catalog containing various rare features -->
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <?catalog-control mode="strict"?>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment inside CDATA -->
      <item>&e2;</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <comment_holder>&e2;</comment_holder>
</catalog>
```

    &recEnt;

</database>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY prodA "Product Alpha">
  <!ENTITY prodB "&prodA; Beta">
  <!ENTITY % attrDecl "<!ATTLIST product code ID #REQUIRED>">
  %attrDecl;
  <?xml-debug log="enabled"?>
]>
<!-- Inventory System DTD and Namespace test -->
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inv" xmlns:store="http://example.org/store">
  <!-- Comment inside inventory body -->
  <?store:config refresh="true"?>
  <product code="P001">
    <![CDATA[
      Inventory CDATA with &prodB; reference.
    ]]>
  </product>
  <product code="P002">&prodB;</product>
</inventory>

<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entBase "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY entDeriv "&entBase; Derived">
  <!ENTITY % externalDef SYSTEM "def.ent">
  %externalDef;
  <?xml-stylesheet href="print.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Archive Root Comment -->
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <?dc-metadata creator="Admin" date="2023-10-01"?>
  <item dc:identifier="ID-001">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive CDATA section. Contains entity: &entDeriv;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&entDeriv;</item>
</archive>

<!DOCTYPE portfolio [
  <!ELEMENT portfolio (project*)>

  <!ENTITY projName "Project X">
  <!ENTITY % paramDef "<!ENTITY internalProj 'Secret Project'>">

  <?xml-stylesheet href="portfolio.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Portfolio Document Comment -->
<portfolio xmlns="http://example.org/portfolio" xmlns:p="http://example.org/project">

  <project p:id="101">
    <![CDATA[
      Project CDATA block: &projName; and &internalProj;
    ]]>
  </project>
  <project p:id="102">&internalProj;</project>
</portfolio>

  <!ENTITY setVal "ProductionMode">
  <!ENTITY % cfgMacro "<!ATTLIST setting name CDATA #REQUIRED>">

]>
<!-- Configuration Root Comment -->
<configuration xmlns="http://example.org/config" xmlns:env="http://example.org/env">
  <?env:property name="timeout" value="30"?>
  <setting name="mode">
    <![CDATA[
      Configuration CDATA section: &setVal;
    ]]>
  </setting>
  <setting name="alias">&setVal;</setting>
</configuration>
